player_prompt.intro:
Ati Player {player_id} kaardhuf Indian Poker.
- 52-kaardhuf; ati kaardi opponenti kanaa argisi.
- Ante {ante} chip(s) har-round, {max_rounds} round(s) guutu.
- Tokkeetti dhaadheetti: '[check]'  |  '[bet X]'  |  '[call]'  |  '[raise X]'  |  '[fold]'  (X positive integer <= chip count ati).
- Kaardi hidden uumee guddaa pot at showdown.

invalid_move.ambiguous: Tokko tokkeetti bracketed action ilaali, fm '[check]', '[bet 2]', '[call]', '[raise 3]', ykn '[fold]'.
invalid_move.cannot_check: [check] hin danda'u - ati qamaarsaa keessa jirta.
invalid_move.nothing_to_call: Waan waamuu hin qabne; bakka isaa [check] gochuu dandeessa.
invalid_move.no_bet_to_raise: [bet X] banuuf fayyadami; kaffalamuudhaaf gatii hin jiru.
